fullPassage: People's happiness depends not on their absolute wealth, but rather on their wealth relative to those around them. In one experiment, two capuchin monkeys were initially perfectly content with a reward of cucumbers when they successfully performed a task. But when one monkey was later given tastier grapes as a reward, the monkey receiving plain old cucumbers became enraged, angrily throwing the previously satisfactory salad vegetable at its handler. The monkeys' economy had grown, since grapes are better than cucumbers. But the resulting inequality brought only discontent. Humans are the same. When employees at the University of California were given information about the salaries of their peers, those discovering they were paid below the average suddenly became less satisfied and more likely to seek a new job. The attitudes of those earning above the average were happily unaffected.

① <u>indifference</u>: (무관심) — 원문 happiness(행복). 글 전체 주제가 '행복이 상대적 부에 달려 있다'이므로 indifference 부적절. ←정답

det.korean: 경제가 성장했지만 결과적 '불평등(inequality)'이 불만을 초래. 번영(prosperity)은 불만의 원인이 될 수 없어 문맥 부적합.
det.analysis:

② <u>enraged</u>: (격분한) — 오이 원숭이가 격분. 적절.

③ <u>prosperity</u>: (번영) — 원문 inequality(불평등). '번영이 불만만 가져왔다'는 논리 모순. 불평등→불만이 자연스러움. ←정답

④ <u>satisfied</u>: (만족한) — became less satisfied. 적절.

→ 근거: 'but rather on ____'. not A but rather B 구문에서 B에 해당. 원숭이 실험+직원 연구 모두 상대적 비교가 핵심. ←정답

questions.passage: People's happiness depends not on their absolute wealth, but rather on their wealth relative to those around them. In one experiment, two capuchin monkeys were initially perfectly content with a reward of cucumbers when they successfully performed a task. But when one monkey was later given tastier grapes as a reward, the monkey receiving plain old cucumbers became enraged, angrily throwing the previously satisfactory salad vegetable at its handler. The monkeys' economy had grown, since grapes are better than cucumbers. But the resulting inequality brought only discontent. Humans are the same. When employees at the University of California were given information about the salaries of their peers, those discovering they were paid below the average suddenly became less satisfied and more likely to seek a new job. The attitudes of those earning above the average were happily unaffected.
questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 행복은 절대적 물질적 이득보다 사회적 비교에 의해 더 좌우된다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① Happiness is shaped more by social comparison than by absolute material gains.
(행복은 절대적 물질적 이득보다 사회적 비교에 의해 더 좌우된다)
→ 근거: 원숭이(오이 vs 포도 비교)와 인간(급여 비교) 모두 상대적 비교가 만족도 결정. ←정답

❌ ② Economic inequality inevitably leads to social instability and conflict.
(경제적 불평등은 필연적으로 사회적 불안과 갈등을 초래한다)
→ 본문: 불평등→불만은 언급하나 사회적 불안/갈등까지는 아님. 과도한 일반화.

❌ ③ Animal experiments provide limited insight into complex human emotions.
(동물 실험은 복잡한 인간 감정에 제한적 통찰만 제공한다)
→ 본문: 'Humans are the same'. 오히려 동물 실험이 인간에 적용됨.

❌ ④ Salary disclosure policies should be avoided to maintain employee morale.
(직원 사기를 위해 급여 공개 정책을 피해야 한다)
→ 본문: 급여 공개 자체를 비판하지 않음. 상대적 비교의 효과를 설명할 뿐.
det.tip: 요지 = social comparison > absolute gains. not A but rather B 구문이 핵심.
